title: Linux / Amethyst test coverage and retirement audit
scope: All 266 failures remaining after the four product fixes. Passing tests were searched for equivalent assertions, not exhaustively audited for redundancy.
policy: Remove only a test whose portable intent is covered by passing assertions, or a platform-only control whose useful product outcomes remain tested. Keep unique behavior until a replacement passes. A related test is not equivalent coverage.
limits: This is a conservative removal audit, not a claim that every retained test is unique. No complete replacement was established for retained rows.
The 263 retained failures are unresolved test/coverage work. Fixture repair may expose additional product defects; they are not declared harmless or release-ready.
Windows execution was not performed. No Windows behavior equivalence is claimed.
No production behavior, public MCP schema, record coverage, live Skyrim profile, deployment or publication changed in this audit.

provenance.revision_note: HEAD alone does not identify the tested working tree. Exact removed snippets and source hashes are in removed-tests.json; run hashes identify the raw TRX evidence.
provenance.environment: Linux x64, .NET 9, Release; synthetic Amethyst filegraph extension enabled.
provenance.raw_evidence_policy: Raw TRX/logs remain private because they contain machine-specific paths. The public report carries run hashes, outcomes and repository-relative source locations.

verification.comparison: Only the three ledger cases disappeared; every retained test has the same outcome.
verification.comparison_method: Compare multisets of (TRX display name, outcome), preserving duplicate theory display names. Counts include all result occurrences, not just distinct names.
verification.build: Release build passed with zero errors; existing analyzer warnings remain.

windows_file_semantics.title: File locks, failed writes and creation times
windows_file_semantics.cause: Windows sharing violations, settable creation times or read-only deletion rules are assumed. A Linux open handle does not necessarily prevent rename or replacement.
windows_file_semantics.coverage: Related recovery and preservation checks pass. They do not establish every individual write route or metadata contract. Two reviewed controls are removed separately.
work: For each retained write route, force a deterministic failure at its actual commit boundary; assert the original bytes survive, the error is explicit, and partial output/metadata is cleaned up.

For creation-time tests, identify the supported Linux metadata/order contract first. Preserve new-byte assertions and prove saved mod ordering is unchanged; do not replace an unsupported timestamp assertion with an unconditional pass.

For installer cases, drive the Linux installer with an actual busy/failed-activation condition and failed skill cleanup. Check the active installation and registration remain usable. A Windows held DLL is not this mechanism.
